Name: Junimo Storage Manager
Author: Sinbad37
Description:
Junimo Storage Manager
[b]Junimo Storage Manager turns Junimo Chests into a network-based storage and collection system.[/b]
Use Junimo Chests as [b]Storage Anchors[/b] and [b]Collectors[/b] to connect storage chests, machines, tappers, trees, Junimo Huts, and other supported sources.
[b]Collectors gather → the Storage Anchor receives → filtered chests store.[/b]
[b]🛠️ Optional Junimo Chest Crafting
Junimo Chest crafting can be enabled in the configuration menu. Disabled by default.
[/b]
[line]
🟣 Storage Anchor
The [b]Storage Anchor[/b] is the central point of your storage network.
Connect it to normal Chests and Big Chests. Items reaching the Anchor are automatically routed to the appropriate chest using [b]Convenient Chests 2[/b] filters.
[code]                    🟣 STORAGE ANCHOR
                           │
             ┌─────────────┼─────────────┐
             ▼             ▼             ▼
           Chest         Chest         Chest
           Crops      Artisan Goods      Ores[/code][line]
🟣 Collector
A [b]Collector[/b] is a Junimo Chest placed near the things you want to collect.
Collectors can connect to:
[list]
[*]Machines & Crystalariums[/*]
[*]Tappers[/*]
[*]Trees[/*]
[*]Junimo Huts[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50180]Junimo Harvest Chest[/url][/*]
[/list]Collected items are sent through the network to the Storage Anchor.
[code]     Keg ─┐
     Jar ─┤
   Tapper ┤
    Tree ─┤
          ▼
     🟣 COLLECTOR
          │
          ▼
   🟣 STORAGE ANCHOR
          │
     ┌────┼────┐
     ▼    ▼    ▼
   Chest Chest Chest[/code][b]Collectors are collection points, not storage destinations.[/b]
[line]
🌳 Trees & Tappers
Trees can be connected through [b]paths or flooring[/b], allowing one Collector to service a larger area.
[code]🌳 ─ 🌳 ─ 🌳 ─ 🌳 ─ 🌳
└────── Path / Flooring ──────┐
                              ▼
                        🟣 Collector[/code]The optional [b]Tree Shaking[/b] feature can also shake connected trees and collect eligible drops.
[line]
🏠 Junimo Huts & Harvest Chest
[b]Junimo Huts[/b] can send harvested crops into the network.
If you use [b]Junimo Harvest Chest[/b], Junimo Storage Manager can collect eligible items stored by it while leaving its normal harvesting and replanting behavior intact.
[line]
📦 Storage Filtering
[b]Convenient Chests 2 is required.[/b]
Junimo Storage Manager uses its filters to determine where items should be stored.
You can therefore organize your storage however you like:
[code]🟣 Storage Anchor
      │
      ├── Chest → Crops
      ├── Chest → Artisan Goods
      ├── Chest → Ores & Bars
      ├── Chest → Minerals
      └── Chest → Wood & Forage[/code]No separate filtering system is added by this mod.
[line]
    Trees                  Machines                  Tappers
      │                            │                               │
     ▼                           ▼                             ▼
🟣 Collector        🟣 Collector          🟣 Collector
           │                           │                              │
           └───────────┴────┬───────┘
                                                      ▼
                                 🟣 STORAGE ANCHOR

[line]
⚙️ Setup
[list=1]
[*]Place your storage Chests and Big Chests.[/*]
[*]Configure their filters with [b]Convenient Chests 2[/b].[/*]
[*]Place a [b]Storage Anchor[/b].[/*]
[*]Connect your storage to the Anchor.[/*]
[*]Place [b]Collectors[/b] near your machines, trees, tappers, or other supported sources.[/*]
[*]Connect everything using the supported network connections.[/*]
[/list]Then let the Junimos handle the rest.
[line]
🤖 Automate Compatibility
[b]Automate is optional and compatible.[/b]
However, Automate may treat Collector Junimo Chests as normal storage.
If you use Automate, make sure it [b]does not use your Collector chests as storage destinations[/b].
[line]
⚠️ Important
[list]
[*]Junimo Chests act as [b]Anchors or Collectors[/b], not final storage.[/*]
[*]The mod does not continuously reorganize items already inside normal chests.[/*]
[*][b]Convenient Chests 2[/b] handles storage filtering.[/*]
[*][b]Automate is not required.[/b][/*]
[/list][line]
Quick Summary
[b]🟣 Collector[/b]
Collects items from supported sources.
[b]🟣 Storage Anchor[/b]
Receives and distributes collected items.
[b]📦 Chests[/b]
Store items according to their Convenient Chests 2 filters.
[code]SOURCE
  ↓
🟣 COLLECTOR
  ↓
🟣 STORAGE ANCHOR
  ↓
📦 FILTERED CHEST[/code][b]Collectors gather. The Anchor distributes. Convenient Chests 2 decides where things go.[/b]
[line]
[heading]Credits[/heading]
Thanks to the[b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32558]Convenient Chests 2[/url][/b] author ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/SummerFleur]SummerFleur[/url]) for the filtering API this mod depends on.  
Special thanks to [b]ChatGPT[/b] for help with code structure, debugging, and polishing the mod.
